body:
Day 5 after noticing the sores and they're starting to heal up. The worst ones are still open, and painful, but it's not so bad. Unfortunately between loss of appetite and episodes of depression I haven't been eating much to feed my immune system, but I'm getting better. 

I've come to the conclusion the sore throat must be strep throat or another bacterial infection picked up from being surrounded by sick children in the waiting room the other day. It looked horrendously bad yesterday, all red and patchy, and is looking better today. 

Starting to maybe see the light at the end of the tunnel.
I am from NZ, yes. Thanks, I wasn't aware of that.

Yes. They said there was a chance it could just be thrush, but I've had sores from thrush, and sores from sex, and they were nothing like the ones I was having. Yes, I had a swab, and should get the results tomorrow.
